// Conductor del lado Staff del gate: llama EXACTAMENTE las RPC que usa el
// Panel, con un usuario staff real, sesion de identidad registrada y JWT propio.
// Solo habla con el backend descartable local.
const API = process.env.GATE_API || 'http://127.0.0.1:54421';
[EXCLUIDO: credencial/configuración; recrear localmente.]
const BUSINESS = 'b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const RIDER = '1fe4d525-34f1-4727-b405-6c5da7308c5f';

const ORDERS = {
  A: '0a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',
  B: '0a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002',
  C: '0a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003',
  D: '0a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004',
  E: '0a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005',
};

async function login(email, password) {
  const r = await fetch(`${API}/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { apikey: ANON, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
  });
  const j = await r.json();
  if (!j.access_token) throw new Error('login fallo: ' + JSON.stringify(j));
  return j.access_token;
}

async function rpc(token, fn, args = {}) {
  const r = await fetch(`${API}/rest/v1/rpc/${fn}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      apikey: ANON,
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(args),
  });
  const text = await r.text();
  let body;
  try { body = JSON.parse(text); } catch { body = text; }
  return { status: r.status, body };
}

export async function staffToken() {
  const token = await login('staff-qa@gate.invalid', 'GateQA-2026-staff');
  await rpc(token, 'identity_register_session', { p_business_id: BUSINESS, p_client: 'panel_web' });
  return token;
}

const cmd = process.argv[2];
const arg = process.argv[3];

const token = await staffToken();
let out;
switch (cmd) {
  case 'offer':
    out = await rpc(token, 'offer_order_to_rider', {
      p_order_id: ORDERS[arg],
      p_expected_status: 'ready',
      p_expected_rider_user_id: null,
      p_new_rider_user_id: RIDER,
    });
    break;
  case 'riders':
    out = await rpc(token, 'list_active_business_riders', { p_business_id: BUSINESS });
    break;
  case 'offers':
    out = await rpc(token, 'list_rider_order_offers', { p_business_id: BUSINESS });
    break;
  case 'withdraw':
    out = await rpc(token, 'withdraw_rider_order_offer', { p_offer_id: arg });
    break;
  default:
    throw new Error('uso: node panel.mjs offer|riders|offers|withdraw [arg]');
}
console.log(JSON.stringify(out, null, 2));
